findings.title: Tie samples to actual per-type counts and reject invalid/duplicate identities
findings.mechanism: The driver requires only a nonzero sample count for a nonempty family, a global cap and n<cases. It does not bound point tag to0..5 or impact type to0..7, reject duplicate family/case n, enforce per-tag/type limits, or require the sample count production emits for each impact type. Concrete existing positive stand-in: impacts=5, t0=5, samples_per_impact_type=4, but only one type0 sample. Every current guard accepts it, although production must emit min(5,4)=4. Thus a partially missing/corrupt raw sample record can be labelled complete; the positive collaborator itself is not a complete production-shaped sample report.
findings.bounded_correction: Validate fixed header sample quotas against the fixture constants; range-check tags/types; require unique case IDs within each family and per-tag/type caps. Derive required impact samples per type as min(tN, quota) and require that exact count. Preserve valid zero-case families; update the collaborator to emit the required samples and add single-defect dropped/duplicate/out-of-range sample controls. Point-tag population is not in the report, so do not invent unavailable per-tag totals.
findings.evidence_level: Verified source failure mechanism; no Lua/test/native reproduction executed by reviewer.
